items.title: Norway links energy firm cyberattacks to critical Azure API Management flaw

items.lede: Microsoft is warning customers that a security vulnerability in Azure API Management (APIM) Classic tiers was exploited to steal stored API credentials, with Norwegian authorities linking the flaw to cyberattacks against energy companies. [...]
items.title: Microsoft Azure flaw exploited to steal customers' API credentials
